description: Find JavaScript served from a given CDN (for example 'cloudflare' or 'jsdelivr'), with totals, the top serving domains and cache status; unpinned_only keeps scripts loaded without a fixed version.

cdn_cache_status.description: Only responses with this CDN cache status, for example HIT or MISS.
cdn_cache_status.title: Cdn Cache Status

cdn_type.description: CDN, for example cloudflare, jsdelivr or unpkg.
cdn_type.title: Cdn Type

unpinned_only.description: Only scripts loaded without a pinned version.
unpinned_only.title: Unpinned Only
